sup:70410.subject: Mechanical seal 24 mm – firm two-year commitment for full allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. We would like to propose a reciprocal trade.

On delivery, we can agree to your 54-day lead time instead of the 42-day standard lead time recorded in our framework agreement (ctr:4600070410#5.1). On commitment, your capacity letter of 18 September 2026 says you will prioritise firm, long-term commitments, so we offer 23,400 pcs per year, binding in each year, over a 24-month term.

In return, we ask for full allocation of that volume at EUR 29.89/unit. Payment is 30 days net, DAP, effective 2027-01-01, with no index clause and no tooling.

Our buyer estimate is EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty (cost:340010); it is a buyer benchmark, not your disclosed cost.

Does this trade work for you?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Re: Mechanical seal 24 mm – firm two-year commitment for full allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We note your proposal for a 24-month commitment at 23,400 units per year. 

We can offer EUR 31.60 per unit for this extended term and volume. For our Angebot, this means a price of €31.60 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Which volume can you commit to? 

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Legal Department: Please be advised that our general terms and conditions apply exclusively, and the quote lists our standard terms.

sup:70410.subject: Seal 24 mm: three-year commitment at full volume
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised quotation and for taking our estimate into account.

To answer your question: we can commit to 23,400 pcs per year, binding in each year.

We would like to move closer to you, so we propose a broader package:

- Price: EUR 31.07/unit. This is up from the EUR 29.89/unit we proposed earlier.
- Term: 36 months, adding a third committed year.
- Volume: 23,400 pcs per year, binding in each year, with full allocation.
- Lead time: 54 days. We accept this instead of the 42-day standard in our framework agreement.
- Fixed terms: payment 30 days net, DAP, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause and no tooling.

This gives you a firm, long-term commitment of the kind your capacity letter says you prioritise. In return, we ask that the complete price recognise both the longer commitment and the delivery flexibility we are accepting.

Does this package work for you?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Re: Seal 24 mm: three-year commitment at full volume
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We note your proposal for a 36-month commitment at 23,400 units per year. In exchange for this extended term, we can adjust our price to EUR 31.40 per unit. The lead time remains at 54 days, and our standard terms apply exclusively. 

For our planning, which volume can you commit to? Furthermore, which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. 

Please note that our current proposal represents a price of €31.40 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. This offer stays valid for 7 days. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
